verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵ֭שֵׁב לִלְח֣וֹם אֶת־ מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·šêḇ lil·ḥō·wm ’eṯ- mō·wō·šêl bîn tā·ḇîn ’eṯ- ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When you sit down to dine with a ruler consider carefully . . . what is set before you
verses.literalPt: Quando te sentares para comer com um governador, atenta bem para aquele que está diante de ti;

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שַׂכִּ֣ין בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ אִם־ בַּ֖עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā śak·kîn bə·lō·‘e·ḵā ’im- ba·‘al ne·p̄eš ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: and put a knife to your throat if you possess a great appetite
verses.literalPt: Põe uma faca à tua garganta, se fores homem de grande apetite.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭תְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ʾå̄w lə·maṭ·‘am·mō·w·ṯāw wə·hū le·ḥem kə·zā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Do not crave his delicacies for that food is deceptive
verses.literalPt: Não cobices as suas gulodices, visto que é comida enganadora.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּיגַ֥ע לְֽהַעֲשִׁ֑יר מִֽבִּינָתְךָ֥ חֲדָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·ḡa‘ lə·ha·‘ă·šîr mib·bî·nā·ṯə·ḵā ḥă·ḏāl
verses.literal: Do not wear yourself out to get rich be wise enough to restrain yourself
verses.literalPt: Não te fatigues para seres rico; dá de mão à tua sabedoria.

verses.original: הֲתָעוּף עֵינֶ֥יךָ בּ֗וֹ וְֽאֵ֫ינֶ֥נּוּ כִּ֤י עָשֹׂ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֣וֹ כְנָפַ֑יִם כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר וְעָיֵף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯå̄·ʿūp̄ ‘ê·ne·ḵā bōw wə·’ê·nen·nū kî ‘ā·śōh ya·‘ă·śeh- lōw ḵə·nā·p̄a·yim kə·ne·šer wə·ʿå̄·yēp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: When you glance . . . at wealth it disappears for it makes . . . wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky
verses.literalPt: Queres pôr os teus olhos naquilo que não é? Pois, sem dúvida, as riquezas fazem para si asas, como a águia que voa para o céu.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּלְחַ֗ם אֶת־ לֶ֭חֶם רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְאַל־ תִּתְאָו לְמַטְעַמֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- til·ḥam ’eṯ- le·ḥem ra‘ ‘ā·yin wə·’al- tiṯ·ʾå̄w lə·maṭ·‘am·mō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Do not eat the bread of a stingy man . . . and do not crave his delicacies
verses.literalPt: Não comas o pão do homem miserável, nem cobices as suas gulodices:

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ כְּמוֹ־ שָׁעַ֥ר בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ כֶּ֫ן־ ה֥וּא אֱכֹ֣ל וּ֭שְׁתֵה יֹ֣אמַר לָ֑ךְ וְ֝לִבּ֗וֹ בַּל־ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî kə·mōw- šā·‘ar bə·nap̄·šōw ken- hū ’ĕ·ḵōl ū·šə·ṯêh yō·mar lāḵ wə·lib·bōw bal- ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: for he is keeping track inwardly counting the cost . . . Eat and drink he says to you but his heart is not with you
verses.literalPt: Porque ele é tal quais são os seus pensamentos: Come e bebe, te diz ele, mas o seu coração não está contigo.

verses.original: פִּֽתְּךָ־ אָכַ֥לְתָּ תְקִיאֶ֑נָּה וְ֝שִׁחַ֗תָּ דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ הַנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: pit·tə·ḵā- ’ā·ḵal·tā ṯə·qî·’en·nāh wə·ši·ḥa·tā də·ḇā·re·ḵā han·nə·‘î·mîm
verses.literal: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words
verses.literalPt: Vomitarás o bocado que comeste e perderás as tuas doces palavras.

verses.original: בְּאָזְנֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל אַל־ תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־ יָ֝ב֗וּז לְשֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·zə·nê ḵə·sîl ’al- tə·ḏab·bêr kî- yā·ḇūz lə·śê·ḵel mil·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not speak to a fool for he will despise the wisdom of your words
verses.literalPt: Não fales aos ouvidos do tolo, porque desprezará a sabedoria das tuas palavras.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם וּבִשְׂדֵ֥י יְ֝תוֹמִ֗ים אַל־ תָּבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·sêḡ gə·ḇūl ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḇiś·ḏê yə·ṯō·w·mîm ’al- tā·ḇō
verses.literal: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless
verses.literalPt: Não removas o antigo marco, nem entres nos campos dos órfãos,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גֹאֲלָ֥ם חָזָ֑ק הֽוּא־ יָרִ֖יב אֶת־ רִיבָ֣ם אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡō·’ă·lām ḥā·zāq hū- yā·rîḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇām ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: for their Redeemer is strong He will take up their case against you
verses.literalPt: pois o seu redentor é forte e lhes pleiteará a causa contra ti.

verses.original: הָבִ֣יאָה לַמּוּסָ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝אָזְנֶ֗ךָ לְאִמְרֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî·’āh lam·mū·sār lib·be·ḵā wə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā lə·’im·rê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge
verses.literalPt: Aplica o teu coração à instrução e os teus ouvidos, às palavras do conhecimento.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּמְנַ֣ע מִנַּ֣עַר מוּסָ֑ר כִּֽי־ תַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַ֝שֵּׁ֗בֶט לֹ֣א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tim·na‘ min·na·‘ar mū·sār kî- ṯak·ken·nū ḇaš·šê·ḇeṭ lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Do not withhold discipline from a child although you strike him with a rod he will not die
verses.literalPt: Não retires da criança a correção, pois, se a fustigares com a vara, não há de morrer.

verses.original: אַ֭תָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh baš·šê·ḇeṭ tak·ken·nū wə·nap̄·šōw miš·šə·’ō·wl taṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Strike him with a rod and you will deliver his soul from Sheol
verses.literalPt: Tu a fustigarás com a vara e livrarás a sua alma do Sheol.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ חָכַ֣ם לִבֶּ֑ךָ יִשְׂמַ֖ח לִבִּ֣י גַם־ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- ḥā·ḵam lib·be·ḵā yiś·maḥ lib·bî ḡam- ’ā·nî
verses.literal: My son if your heart is wise my own heart will indeed . . . rejoice
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, se o teu coração for sábio, alegrar-se-á o meu coração dentro de mim.

verses.original: וְתַעְלֹ֥זְנָה כִלְיוֹתָ֑י בְּדַבֵּ֥ר שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יךָ מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯa‘·lō·zə·nāh ḵil·yō·w·ṯāy bə·ḏab·bêr śə·p̲ā·t̲ê·k̲ā mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right
verses.literalPt: Também se regozijarão os meus rins, quando os teus lábios falarem coisas retas.

verses.original: אַל־ יְקַנֵּ֣א לִ֭בְּךָ בַּֽחַטָּאִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־ בְּיִרְאַת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yə·qan·nê lib·bə·ḵā ba·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm kî ’im- bə·yir·’aṯ- Yah·weh kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Do not let your heart envy sinners but . . . always continue . . . in the fear of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não inveje o teu coração aos pecadores, mas conserva-te no temor de Jeová continuamente.

verses.original: כִּ֭י אִם־ יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yêš ’a·ḥă·rîṯ wə·ṯiq·wā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: For surely there is a future and your hope will not be cut off
verses.literalPt: Pois deveras há uma recompensa, e não será cortada a tua esperança.

verses.original: שְׁמַע־ אַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֣י וַחֲכָ֑ם וְאַשֵּׁ֖ר בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- ’at·tāh ḇə·nî wa·ḥă·ḵām wə·’aš·šêr bad·de·reḵ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen . . . my son and be wise and guide your heart on the right course
verses.literalPt: Ouve, filho meu, sê sábio, e guia no caminho reto o teu coração.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֥י בְסֹֽבְאֵי־ יָ֑יִן בְּזֹלֲלֵ֖י בָשָׂ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ḇə·sō·ḇə·’ê- yā·yin bə·zō·lă·lê ḇā·śār lā·mōw
verses.literal: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat
verses.literalPt: Não estejas entre os bebedores de vinho, nem entre os comilões de carne.

verses.original: כִּי־ סֹבֵ֣א וְ֭זוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵ֑שׁ וּ֝קְרָעִ֗ים תַּלְבִּ֥ישׁ נוּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- sō·ḇê wə·zō·w·lêl yiw·wā·rêš ū·qə·rā·‘îm tal·bîš nū·māh
verses.literal: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty and drowsiness will clothe them in rags
verses.literalPt: Porque o bebedor de vinho e o comilão empobrecerão; a sonolência cobrirá de trapos o homem.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־ תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי־ זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ lə·’ā·ḇî·ḵā zeh yə·lā·ḏe·ḵā wə·’al- tā·ḇūz kî- zā·qə·nāh ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen to your father who gave you life and do not despise your mother when she is old
verses.literalPt: Ouve a teu pai, que te gerou, e não desprezes a tua mãe, quando ela for velha.

verses.original: אֱמֶ֣ת קְ֭נֵה וְאַל־ תִּמְכֹּ֑ר חָכְמָ֖ה וּמוּסָ֣ר וּבִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·meṯ qə·nêh wə·’al- tim·kōr ḥāḵ·māh ū·mū·sār ū·ḇî·nāh
verses.literal: Invest in truth and never sell it in wisdom and instruction and understanding
verses.literalPt: Compra a verdade e não a vendas; sim, a sabedoria, e a instrução, e o entendimento.

verses.original: גּוֹל יָגוֹל אֲבִ֣י צַדִּ֑יק יוֹלֵד חָ֝כָ֗ם וְיִשְׂמַח בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gōl yå̄·ḡōl ’ă·ḇî ṣad·dîq yō·lēḏ ḥā·ḵām wə·yiś·maḥ bōw
verses.literal: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice . . . and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him . . .
verses.literalPt: Grandemente se regozijará o pai do justo; e quem gerar a um filho sábio nele se alegrará.

verses.original: יִֽשְׂמַח־ אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝תָגֵ֗ל יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·maḥ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’im·me·ḵā wə·ṯā·ḡêl yō·w·laḏ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: May your father and mother be glad and may she who gave you birth rejoice
verses.literalPt: Alegrem-se teu pai e tua mãe, e regozije-se aquela que te deu à luz.

verses.original: תְּנָֽה־ בְנִ֣י לִבְּךָ֣ לִ֑י וְ֝עֵינֶ֗יךָ דְּרָכַ֥י תִּרְצֶנָה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nāh- ḇə·nî lib·bə·ḵā lî wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā də·rā·ḵay tir·ṣɛ·nå̄h
verses.literal: My son give me your heart and let your eyes delight in my ways
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, dá-me o teu coração, e deleitem-se os teus olhos nos meus caminhos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲמֻקָּ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וּבְאֵ֥ר צָ֝רָ֗ה נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šū·ḥāh ‘ă·muq·qāh zō·w·nāh ū·ḇə·’êr ṣā·rāh nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: For a prostitute is a deep pit and an adulteress is a narrow well
verses.literalPt: Pois cova profunda é a prostituta, e poço estreito é a mulher estranha.

verses.original: אַף־ הִ֭יא כְּחֶ֣תֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- hî kə·ḥe·ṯep̄ te·’ĕ·rōḇ ū·ḇō·wḡ·ḏîm bə·’ā·ḏām tō·w·sip̄
verses.literal: Like a robber she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men
verses.literalPt: Ela, como salteador, se põe em emboscada e multiplica entre os homens os prevaricadores.

verses.original: לְמִ֨י א֥וֹי לְמִ֪י אֲב֡וֹי לְמִ֤י מְדוֹנִים לְמִ֥י שִׂ֗יחַ לְ֭מִי פְּצָעִ֣ים חִנָּ֑ם לְ֝מִ֗י חַכְלִל֥וּת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mî ’ō·w lə·mî ’ă·ḇō·w lə·mî mə·ḏō·nīm lə·mî śî·aḥ lə·mî pə·ṣā·‘îm ḥin·nām lə·mî ḥaḵ·li·lūṯ ‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: Who has woe Who has sorrow Who has contentions Who has complaints Who has needless wounds Who has bloodshot eyes
verses.literalPt: Para quem os ais? Para quem os pesares? Para quem as rixas? Para quem as queixas? Para quem as feridas sem causa? Para quem os olhos vermelhos?

verses.original: לַֽמְאַחֲרִ֥ים עַל־ הַיָּ֑יִן לַ֝בָּאִ֗ים לַחְקֹ֥ר מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·’a·ḥă·rîm ‘al- hay·yā·yin lab·bā·’îm laḥ·qōr mim·sāḵ
verses.literal: Those who linger over wine who go to taste mixed drinks
verses.literalPt: Para os que se demoram em beber vinho; para os que vão em procura de vinho misturado.

verses.original: אַל־ תֵּ֥רֶא יַיִן֮ כִּ֪י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם כִּֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן בַּכִּיס עֵינ֑וֹ יִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tê·re ya·yin kî yiṯ·’ad·dām kî- yit·tên bak·kīs ‘ê·nōw yiṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: Do not gaze at wine while it is red when it sparkles in the cup . . . and goes down smoothly . . .
verses.literalPt: Não olhes para o vinho, quando se mostra vermelho, quando resplandece no copo, quando se escoa suavemente;

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָ֣שׁ יִשָּׁ֑ךְ וּֽכְצִפְעֹנִ֥י יַפְרִֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw kə·nā·ḥāš yiš·šāḵ ū·ḵə·ṣip̄·‘ō·nî yap̄·riš
verses.literal: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper
verses.literalPt: no fim, morde como uma serpente e pica como um basilisco.

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּ זָר֑וֹת וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ יְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ne·ḵā yir·’ū zā·rō·wṯ wə·lib·bə·ḵā yə·ḏab·bêr tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your eyes will see strange things and your mind will utter perversities
verses.literalPt: Os teus olhos verão coisas estranhas, e o teu coração falará coisas perversas.

verses.original: וְ֭הָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּלֶב־ יָ֑ם וּ֝כְשֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּרֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā kə·šō·ḵêḇ bə·leḇ- yām ū·ḵə·šō·ḵêḇ bə·rōš ḥib·bêl
verses.literal: You will be like one sleeping . . . on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast
verses.literalPt: Serás como o que se deita no meio do mar ou como o que se deita no topo dum mastro

verses.original: הִכּ֥וּנִי בַל־ חָלִיתִי֮ הֲלָמ֗וּנִי בַּל־ יָ֫דָ֥עְתִּי מָתַ֥י אָקִ֑יץ א֝וֹסִ֗יף אֲבַקְשֶׁ֥נּוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: hik·kū·nî ḇal- ḥā·lî·ṯî hă·lā·mū·nî bal- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî mā·ṯay ’ā·qîṣ ’ō·w·sîp̄ ’ă·ḇaq·šen·nū ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: They struck me but I feel no pain They beat me but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink
verses.literalPt: e dirás: Espancaram-me, e não me doeu; deram em mim, e não o senti. Quando despertarei? Tornarei a buscá-lo outra vez.
